description: This file defines a React functional component 'Header' that renders a navigation bar with links for notes, login, register, and logout, depending on authentication status. It manages user authentication state and provides a logout function with navigation handling.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: React functional component rendering the navigation header with authentication-aware links and logout functionality.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function that logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
